description: This file defines the class FencedCodeRenderer, which implements custom rendering logic for fenced code blocks in Markdown, including syntax highlighting and special handling for 'tex' and 'mermaid' blocks.

classes.name: FencedCodeRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of fenced code blocks in Markdown, supporting syntax highlighting and special block types such as 'tex' and 'mermaid'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a new Highlighter instance.

methods.name: pre
methods.description: Wraps content in HTML <pre> and <code> tags with given attributes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a fenced code node, applying syntax highlighting if applicable, or handling special block types.

methods.name: renderCode
methods.description: Performs syntax highlighting on code content based on provided language, or escapes it for raw display.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Extracts the language name from info words, returns false if not specified.
